snippet.title: ► GRAND PRIX 3 [720p Gameplay] | Spa 1998 - Windows (Microprose)
snippet.description: Videos of this are quite rare now on YouTube! Here's a 7 lap race, 100% Rain, driven with a G25 wheel and Fanatec pedals. This game is truly amazing and way, way ahead of its time. Still perhaps the best F1 game on the PC.
